study_design: Prospective population-based cohort study with baseline dietary questionnaire and follow-up for cancer incidence through 2009
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The subjects of the present study were 26,464 men (age range: 40-79 years) from 24 districts wherein cancer incidence was reported.
reason: The cohort analyzes occurrence of prostate cancer overall. No stage, grade, metastatic status, high-risk classification, or lethal endpoint is reported in the abstract.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There were 412 cases of prostate cancer in the survey population.
estimate_classifications.reason: The dairy/milk estimate concerns incident prostate cancer overall; the abstract provides no aggressive subtype definition.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Milk and yogurt consumption showed a significantly positive risk and a dose-response relationship adjusted for age, family history of prostate cancer, body mass index, and total energy intake, stratified by area.
estimate_classifications.reason: The yogurt association is with prostate cancer overall, not an aggressive endpoint.
